blocks.text: These include diseases and disorders that affect the teeth, gums, and supporting structures of the mouth. They involve medical disorders that affect the jaw (maxilla and mandible), face, and related structures, such as sinuses, salivary glands, muscles, nerves, blood vessels and temporomandibular joint (TMJ). These conditions may be congenital, traumatic, infectious, neoplastic, or degenerative in nature.

blocks.text: Before doing oral examination or any dental procedures, patients should gurgle with hydrogen peroxide 3% or povidone iodine 0.5% or chlorhexidine gluconate 0.1% to minimize infectious agent’s contamination between patient and oral health care provider.
